cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to price furniture to sell. The sofa's gone, but you're keeping my chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're still dodging the valuation. If someone offered twenty pounds, would you keep it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. I sleep with the cushion. You can stop pretending if you take that price sticker off.

reason: Remove the detachable explanation of emotional value; the pupil grade now leads straight to A reciprocal confession and offer to occupy the chair.
